subtopic: Euler Form, De Moivre's Theorem & Roots of a Complex Number
title: Euler, De Moivre and roots toolkit

segments_english.text: Here is the exponential-form toolkit, all on one board, restated for quick recall.
Euler's formula: e to the i theta equals cosine theta plus i sine theta, and any number is r times e to the i theta.
The inverse relations express the trig functions back: cosine theta as the sum of e to the plus and minus i theta over two, and sine theta as the difference over two i.
De Moivre for powers: z to the n equals r to the n times e to the i n theta, equivalently r to the n times cosine n theta plus i sine n theta.
The roots formula: w sub k equals r to the one over n times e to the i, theta plus two k pi, over n, for k from zero to n minus one, giving exactly n roots.
The roots of unity: one, alpha, up to alpha to the n minus one, with alpha equal to e to the two pi i over n, and they sum to zero.
The cube roots of unity: one, omega, omega squared, with omega cubed one, their sum zero, and omega squared equal to the conjugate of omega.
And the cubic-sum factorization: a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c equals a plus b plus c, times the two omega-factors. Keep this whole board as your quick reference.

segments_hinglish.text: Ye raha exponential-form toolkit, sab ek board par, quick recall ke liye restate kiya hua.
Euler's formula: e to the i theta barabar cosine theta plus i sine theta, aur koi bhi number hai r times e to the i theta.
Inverse relations trig functions ko wapas express karte hain: cosine theta as e to the plus aur minus i theta ka sum over two, aur sine theta as difference over two i.
Powers ke liye De Moivre: z to the n barabar r to the n times e to the i n theta, equivalently r to the n times cosine n theta plus i sine n theta.
Roots formula: w sub k barabar r to the one over n times e to the i, theta plus two k pi, over n, k zero se n minus one tak, theek n roots dete hue.
Roots of unity: one, alpha, up to alpha to the n minus one, alpha barabar e to the two pi i over n, aur wo sum hoke zero.
Cube roots of unity: one, omega, omega squared, omega cubed one, unka sum zero, aur omega squared barabar omega ka conjugate.
Aur cubic-sum factorization: a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c barabar a plus b plus c, times do omega-factors. Is poore board ko apna quick reference rakho.
